examples.title: Quick start
examples.notes: Real isolated preload and renderer startup; activation/dock behavior is not implemented.

examples.title: Dark mode
examples.notes: Firefly lacks nativeTheme and public IPC. CSS-only theming does not establish native theme compatibility.

examples.title: Device access
examples.notes: Manual HID selection with a cancel-first native chooser, scoped loopback-origin permissions and explicit user gesture. Bluetooth/serial/USB need separate scoped permissions; none is claimed for Firefly.

examples.title: In-app purchases
examples.notes: Requires a signed Mac App Store sandbox app and configured products. Product lookup is implemented in this reference example; payment/receipt verification must be supplied before enabling purchases. No purchase is run by tests.

examples.title: Keyboard shortcuts
examples.notes: Native menu/global shortcut registration is manual and scoped to this process. Native Firefly shortcut APIs are absent.

examples.title: Deep links
examples.notes: No protocol registration occurs without the explicit environment opt-in. Packaging needs OS protocol declarations. OS delivery and single-instance handling are unsupported in Firefly.

examples.title: Desktop launcher actions
examples.notes: Linux manual packaging example. The .desktop template must be installed with a real absolute executable path; Firefly Linux desktop packaging remains unavailable.

examples.title: Local AI handler
examples.notes: Experimental Electron utility-process integration, not Firefly support. Requires a real local backend module; no fake model is included or inference claimed.

examples.title: Menus
examples.notes: Application and context menus use the real Menu API. Firefly Menu/MenuItem are not implemented.

examples.title: Multithreading
examples.notes: Browser-only module workers; Node/Mite APIs in workers and nodeIntegrationInWorker remain unsupported. File-worker loading and worker execution require their own native test result.

examples.title: Native file drag and drop
examples.notes: Manual native drag interaction. The drag file is fixed in main; renderer input is not a filesystem path. Firefly nativeImage/startDrag/IPC are absent.

examples.title: Navigation history
examples.notes: Uses the current navigationHistory object, not deprecated WebContents goBack aliases. Firefly host history APIs and IPC remain absent.

examples.title: Notifications
examples.notes: Requires OS notification permission. Nothing is posted during automated checks. Firefly Notification is absent.

examples.title: Offscreen rendering
examples.notes: Real offscreen paint events, not screenshots relabeled as offscreen rendering. Firefly offscreen/paint API is absent; no frame-rate performance claim.

examples.title: Online and offline events
examples.notes: Smoke validates initial browser state/listener installation only. Real OS network transition delivery is a separate manual gate; onLine is not proof of internet reachability.

examples.title: Progress bars
examples.notes: Native taskbar/dock progress, not an HTML progress-element substitute. Firefly setProgressBar is absent.

examples.title: Recent documents
examples.notes: This changes the user’s recent-document list only after an explicit button click. Tests do not clear or modify that list. Firefly native recent-document APIs are absent.

examples.title: Represented file
examples.notes: macOS native represented-document icon/edited marker. Firefly methods are absent; an HTML filename is not equivalent.

examples.title: Spellchecker
examples.notes: Native spell suggestions/context menu require manual validation and dictionaries. Firefly spellcheck constructor option/session APIs are unsupported.

examples.title: Web embeds
examples.notes: Runnable browser iframe slice. Native WebContentsView/webview and session/navigation controls remain unsupported; no Chrome extension embedding claim.

examples.title: Taskbar customization
examples.notes: Windows-only native taskbar UI. Firefly Windows desktop and these methods are not implemented; macOS/Linux checks are explicit platform errors.

examples.title: Window customization
examples.notes: Frameless/drag regions use the actual native adapter. This smoke checks construction/page startup; drag gestures and HTML native min/max controls have separate existing Designer/native tests. Title-bar overlay/transparency/fullscreen are not implied.

examples.title: Application lifecycle
examples.notes: Readiness, cancellable normal quit/retry and forced exit. OS activation/dock/shutdown behavior is not implemented.
